name: SPEC_DB_MAIN
description: The SPEC_DB_MAIN table contains basic information about your specimen records. These include clinical pathology, anatomic pathology, and quality control specimens. One row in this table represents one specimen.

columns.name: SPECIMEN_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the specimen record

columns.name: SPEC_NUMBER_LN1
columns.description: The main external identifier of the specimen

columns.name: SPEC_DTM_COLLECTED
columns.description: The date and time when the specimen was collected.

columns.name: SPEC_DTM_RECEIVED
columns.description: The date and time when the specimen was received.

columns.name: SPEC_CONTAINER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the container associated with this specimen

columns.name: SPEC_CONTAINER_ID_CONTAINER_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the container type record.

columns.name: SPEC_SOURCE_C_NAME
columns.description: The specimen source category for the specimen.

columns.name: SPEC_EPT_PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the patient whom this specimen belongs to.

columns.name: SPEC_SUB_SPEC_NO
columns.description: The submitter's specimen number.

columns.name: SPEC_DRAW_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The draw type category number for the specimen

columns.name: SPEC_REQ_GRP_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the requisition grouper associated with this specimen if this is a non-EPT patient

columns.name: REQ_SMT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the submitter that collected this specimen. This is only populated for reference lab specimens.

columns.name: REQ_SMT_ID_RECORD_NAME
columns.description: The name of the submitter record.

columns.name: REQ_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the requisition this specimen is attached to. This is only populated for reference lab specimens.

columns.name: ACUTE_CONVAL_C_NAME
columns.description: The acute/convalescent category number for the specimen record.

columns.name: CASE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the case this specimen is attached to. This is only populated for anatomic pathology specimens.

columns.name: RECV_QUEUE_COMM_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the internal receiving comment that is associated with this specimen.

columns.name: SPEC_COLL_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time when the specimen was collected in the UTC time zone.

columns.name: SPEC_RCVD_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time when the specimen was received in the UTC time zone.

columns.name: SPEC_FROZEN_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether this specimen is a frozen specimen.

columns.name: SPECIMEN_COL_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the specimen collection record which is associated with this specimen.

columns.name: AP_RECEIVE_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time when the anatomic pathology specimen was received in the UTC time zone. This is only populated for anatomic pathology specimens.

columns.name: DRAW_SESS_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time when the draw session this specimen belongs to was started. It is stored in the UTC time zone.

columns.name: SPECIMEN_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The specimen type category ID for the specimen. This is calculated from the specimen type for the first order on the specimen that has a specimen type set and has not been redrawn or removed. If all orders on the specimen have been redrawn or removed, it is calculated from the specimen type for the first removed order that has a specimen type set.

columns.name: SPEC_FROM_DSL_YN
columns.description: Stores whether a specimen was created from the Specimen Linking activity. The default value is No.

columns.name: ONSET_DATE
columns.description: The onset date that symptoms began for the associated specimen. This is a legacy item and this data is no longer populated in Chronicles.

columns.name: BIOHAZARD_C_NAME
columns.description: The biohazard category ID for the specimen. This is legacy data that is no longer populated.

columns.name: DRAW_CHGS_TRGRD_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether draw charges have been triggered for the specimen. 'Y' indicates that a draw charge has been triggered. 'N' or NULL indicate that a draw charge has not been triggered.

columns.name: SPEC_SOURCE
columns.description: The specimen source for the specimen. This is legacy data that is no longer populated.

columns.name: SPEC_ORIGIN_C_NAME
columns.description: The special specimen origin category ID for the specimen.

columns.name: IMPORT_RUN_BATCH_NUMBER_ID
columns.description: The batch ID associated to an imported specimen

columns.name: CREATION_DEPARTMENT_ID_EXTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: The external name of the department record. This is often used in patient correspondence such as reminder letters.

columns.name: COLL_PPID_OVRIDE_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether PPID was overridden during collection for this specimen.

columns.name: COLL_PSID_OVRIDE_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether PSID was overridden during collection for this specimen.

columns.name: REQ_OR_GEN_SUBMITTER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the submitter of the requisition that this specimen is attached to. This is only populated for reference lab specimens. This will include a generic submitter that is placed on orders that were placed at your organization and collected at an EpicCare Link site.

columns.name: REQ_OR_GEN_SUBMITTER_ID_RECORD_NAME
columns.description: The name of the submitter record.

columns.name: COLL_PRTR_OVRIDE_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether a required printer scan was overridden. 'Y' indicates that a printer scan was overridden during the collection process. 'N' or NULL indicates that the printer scan was completed or not required.

columns.name: COLL_PPID_REQ_YN
columns.description: Indicates if positive patient identification (PPID) was required during the collection process (printing labels or collection documentation). Workflows that never require PPID (for example, Requisition Entry) will not populate this item.

columns.name: COLL_PSID_REQ_YN
columns.description: Indicates if positive specimen identification (PSID) was required during collection documentation. Workflows that never require PSID (for example, Requisition Entry) will not populate this item.

columns.name: SPECIAL_ABO_PHENOTYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The nonstandard ABO category ID for the blood product specimen.

columns.name: INTENDED_USE_ATTRIBUTE_C_NAME
columns.description: The indended use category ID for the blood product specimen.

columns.name: BLOOD_GROUP_SPEC_MSG_C_NAME
columns.description: The blood groups special message category ID for the blood product specimen.
entries: No ABO or Rh information is available
Quarantine/hold for further testing or processing
Not for transfusion based on test results

columns.name: COLLECTION_TYPE_CODE_C_NAME
columns.description: The collection type category ID for the donor product specimen.
entries: Volunteer research (Product not intended for human application)
Paid research (Product not intended for human application)
For directed recipient use only, limited exposure
Medical exception, for specified recipient only (allogeneic)
See (i.e., scan) Special Testing bar code
For directed recipient use only, biohazard
For autologous use. Contains allogeneic material.

columns.name: PRODUCT_COLLECTION_DATE
columns.description: The date at which this blood product specimen was collected. This column is populated only for certain blood product types, according to the ISBT-128 specification.

columns.name: PRODUCT_COLLECTION_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time at which this blood product specimen was collected. This column is populated only for certain blood product types, according to the ISBT-128 specification.

columns.name: SPECIAL_TESTING_CODE_C_NAME
columns.description: The special testing "N-Code" category ID for the blood product specimen.

columns.name: RBC_ANTIGEN_BARCODE
columns.description: Stores a barcoded string containing antigen test info for RBC blood product specimens, according to the ISBT-128 specification.

columns.name: PLATELET_ANTIGEN_BARCODE
columns.description: Stores a barcoded string with information about platelet HLA and HPA testing for a blood product specimen, according to the ISBT-128 specification.

columns.name: COLL_TIMER_EXPIRATIONS
columns.description: Indicates how many times a scan workflow timer expired after accessioning for this specimen.

columns.name: PROD_DESC_CODE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the product description code corresonding to this donor product specimen, according to the ISBT-128 specification.

columns.name: PROD_DESC_CODE_ID_PROD_DESC_CODE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the product description code.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The UTC date and time at which this specimen expires.

columns.name: FACILITY_IDENTIFIER_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Unique ID of the submitter corresponding to the donor facility that prepared this product specimen.

columns.name: FACILITY_IDENTIFIER_RECORD_ID_RECORD_NAME
columns.description: The name of the submitter record.

columns.name: DESC_CODE_CSN_ID
columns.description: Stores the CSN of the product description code for this row.

columns.name: ABO_PHENOTYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the ABO blood group type for a blood product specimen, as encoded by a Blood Groups barcode (I OVS 76010).

columns.name: RHD_LAB_ANTIGEN_RESULT_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the RhD type for a blood product specimen, as encoded by a Blood Groups barcode (I OVS 76010).
